articles.summary: PSQ Holdings, Inc. (OTC: PSQH) today issued the following letter to shareholders: November 19, 2026 To Our Shareholders, In February I told you to expect fewer promises and more measurable progress. In July I put a 2026 revenue target of approximately $32 million in writing and asked you to hold us to it. I am writing now because, on November 9, the New York Stock Exchange announced it would begin proceedings to delist our common stock and warrants and immediately suspended trading in both, and I want you to hear directly from me what happens next. NYSE Regulation based its decision on Section 802.01B of the Listed Company Manual, which requires a company’s average market capitalization over 30 consecutive trading days to stay above $15 million, and ours did not. In February, I wrote that share price is feedback and that we have a duty to listen to it. I still believe that. I also wrote that share price can trail what is happening inside a business, and I believe that is the case

articles.summary: Transaction completes the Company’s transition to a focused fintech business; proceeds to strengthen the balance sheet and fund growth initiatives PSQ Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PSQH) (the “Company”) today announced that it has completed the previously announced sale of EveryLife, its direct-to-consumer baby products business, to FreeHold Brands for total consideration of $5.5 million, subject to customary adjustments. “Closing the EveryLife sale completes our move to fintech,” said Dusty Wunderlich, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “Every dollar we invest, and every hour our team works, now goes exclusively toward the merchants and customers who rely on us for payments and financing. EveryLife has a good home with FreeHold Brands.” The Company intends to use the proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet and fund growth initiatives across its fintech businesses. The sale is the final step in the Company’s effort over the last 12 months to refocus its core business on fintech offerings.
articles.title: PSQ Holdings Completes Sale of EveryLife to FreeHold Brands
